summary: Iteration 159 — Event Store polish pass (supporters strip, donor_consent, portal notifications, owner checklist, admin event setup checklist). Backend: 26 passed / 1 skipped (benign ordering — dismiss-all wiped unread set before dismiss-one ran). Frontend: storefront supporters strip + chips render correctly with PII sanitization; portal assignment banner + dismiss + owner checklist verified; admin event-checklist-card code-review confirmed (correct test-id, gated by `store_type === 'event' && eventChecklist`). PII guards confirmed: customer_email/phone/stripe_session_id/cost/profit absent from supporters payload. Cross-tenant guard on checklist endpoint verified (404 for foreign tenant). Cross-customer guard on portal notifications verified (dismiss-other returns 404).
critical_code_review_comments: Supporters endpoint (routes/webstores.py:1002) gating is layered correctly: 404 when store inactive/non-public, [] when not event+fundraiser, [] when show_supporter_names='no'. Final row projection only emits {name, amount, created_at} — PII columns are not selected from Mongo in the first place.
yes_with_permission mode falls back to 'Anonymous Supporter' when donor_consent=false; verified with both consenting and non-consenting seeded rows.
Checklist endpoint correctly tenant-scopes via {id, tenant_id: current_user.tenant_id} — cross-tenant probe returns 404 (verified).
Checklist done flags are pure derivations from existing collections (no tracking table) — store_live flip via direct status change instantly reflects in next GET.
Portal notification dismiss-one uses (id, customer_id) update_one — matched_count==0 returns 404, prevents enumeration. Cross-customer dismiss verified to return 404.
_ensure_webstore_assignment_notifications dedup key is (customer_id, notification_type, related_id) — 3 consecutive GET /api/portal/webstores calls produce exactly 1 notification row (verified).

Frontend admin Event Store Setup card (Webstores.js:2459) correctly gates on `selectedStore.store_type === 'event' && eventChecklist` so creator/business/fundraiser stores never render it. Card sits above Event Settings card per spec.

Storefront supporters-strip + chip test-ids (Storefront.js:529, 538) match spec; donor-consent-checkbox (Storefront.js:802) is conditionally rendered — verified absent when show_supporter_names='yes_all' (correct).

Portal OwnerChecklist (PortalWebstores.js:314) omits questionnaire/fundraiser items for non-event stores — confirmed visually on Demo Fundraiser Store (5 items including assigned/stripe/live/first_order; no questionnaire row).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (storefront strip + portal banner/dismiss/checklist + admin card code gate)

Test fixture snapshots+restores those flags. Reset is_read=False on existing webstore_assigned notification so the portal banner test could exercise dismiss.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All four polish-pass features pass spec. The supporters endpoint is the only NEW public storefront route — PII sanitization is enforced both at the Mongo projection layer and at the response-shape layer. The donor-consent checkbox on the storefront only renders when both (a) show_supporter_names='yes_with_permission' AND (b) effectiveDonation > 0 — to manually exercise, set the store's show_supporter_names to 'yes_with_permission' and pick a donation preset. The admin Event Setup card lives inside the Settings/Branding section of the webstore detail dialog (below Event Details, above Event Settings), gated on store_type==='event' and the fetched eventChecklist object; non-event stores never render it. The portal AssignmentNotificationBanner auto-fetches /api/portal/notifications?notification_type=webstore_assigned&unread_only=true on mount; dismissing posts to /api/portal/notifications/{id}/dismiss and the banner removes that row from local state immediately. Test seed data (TEST_iter159_* orders) was left in place for re-runs — clean it via db.webstore_orders_v2.delete_many({'id': {'$regex': '^TEST_iter159_'}}) when no longer needed.
